amendments.section: G05, G06, O09 and Q139; Paper IV §9; clock theorem §§2–9
amendments.finding: The current ledger retires a universal kappa_loop scalar. Conditional scalar-family algebra survives only on its declared domain. A native action form or numerical internal ratio does not fix a dimensional physical action, clock or gravity scale.

amendments.title: Receipt index needs idle-response correction
amendments.finding: On the admitted pair-response domain, mu_Theta = ind F_omega + |h^-| - |h^+| with h=q-omega, after frame alignment. The index alone is full polarity only if the idle term vanishes. Binding POC-1 saturation fixes the response address; a nontrivial competing burden optimizer is then not a simultaneous final selector.
amendments.scope: Retains conditional index identities and POC-1 as a candidate. Does not turn synthetic counterexamples into a held-out endpoint score.

amendments.title: Signed flux remains a separate diagnostic
amendments.finding: The fixed-K witness has unchanged obligation/index polarity zero but integrated edge-support change 3/8 and one-pair change 1/8. A universal equality between signed support polarity and the integer obligation index fails under those premises.
amendments.scope: Does not invalidate support continuity. A stricter diagnostic domain needs an explicit new contract.

amendments.title: Sidecar distribution and custody
amendments.section: Sidecar recovery v0.1 evidence inventory and reopening procedure
amendments.finding: O45 is a historical pre-distribution status. O47/O49 and the later audit record sent-message distribution evidence; activation, scorer-byte custody and eligible target-hidden native endpoints remain unestablished in the inspected record. SOURCE_INCOMPLETE_NO_SCORE governs scoring.
amendments.scope: Sent does not mean acknowledged or executed. Frozen primary scorer and verdict cannot be repaired by the sidecar.

amendments.title: Native inputs and event timing remain open
amendments.section: Native projection theorem; packet action audit; source recovery; Paper I §7.4
amendments.finding: Current fixed-complex support flow, conditional gates, residual receipts, action and Metropolis acceptance do not supply a normalized packet proposal, native flip/admission law, feedback/renewal, or calibrated physical clock. On filled K4, Q_h=exp(arctan(h) A) is exact, but h and the switch predicate are additional choices.
amendments.scope: Formal source-completion countermodels test logical entailment. They do not establish physically attainable competing histories.

amendments.title: Signature and refinement carrier separation
amendments.section: Lorentzian gate §§2–5; native refinement §3; interface gate §2; governance §7
amendments.finding: A positive real coframe form E delta E^T is positive semidefinite and cannot yield Lorentzian inertia on the same carrier. Fixed K does not select spatial refinement. The strict contract of native contraction, unit singleton readout and unweighted-generator intertwining fails on K4 to sd K4 because 7>3.
amendments.scope: An indefinite internal form, finite event mediator and physical spacetime metric are distinct. Q107 lists counts through degree 3; a full filled 4-simplex also has one 4-cell.

amendments.title: Receipt memory timing and physical resource scale
amendments.section: Entropy session summary; receipt gap frontier clock and non-identifiability; Paper IV §9
amendments.finding: The decomposed write has 34 slots. A 44-slot total deadline leaves 10 storage rounds; 32 post-write rounds require 66 total slots. Gibbs flag probabilities and normalized accuracy do not identify joules, physical area or a fully renewed controller/bath cycle.
amendments.scope: Retains fixed-age calculations with their original schedule. No entropy/horizon normalization is backsolved from Newton G.

amendments.title: Historical Gap 2 sign and parameter audit
amendments.section: Gap2_FINAL_STATUS.md §6, equations A.6 and A.19; historical fits
amendments.finding: For n_s<1, 0<rho<1 and contraction 0<r<1, the displayed -(n_s-1)|ln rho|/ln(1/r) is positive. It cannot equal the reported negative running under those assumptions. Its dependence on n_s also inherits the unresolved n_CMB unless a separate source or conditional measured-pivot forecast is declared.
amendments.scope: A new presentation audit, not a silent correction of the original formula. Recover the scale convention and original derivation/code before selecting a repaired sign or claiming a parameter-free prediction.

amendments.title: Replay counts and review types
amendments.section: Edge replay-count erratum; recorded replication receipts; CRL safeguards
amendments.finding: The edge-receipt count 1551 denotes selected manually counted check groups, not all assertions; the later AST instrumentation reports 1837 evaluated assertions. Gemini replication and separate AI scope audits remain explicitly distinguished from human review and measurement.
amendments.scope: Execution counts do not measure independent experiments. No CRL or physical promotion is made by this atlas.

O33 refers to lab feasibility criteria F01–F12, not the coefficient frame-family rows. Reference names are kept typed by context.
